description: Change a clip's title. Without 'title', Katto's AI writes a new scroll-stopping title in the clip's language (optional style: energetic, descriptive, fun, shocking); each AI regeneration uses one unit of the plan's monthly title-regeneration allowance (an error with 'limit' when it is used up). With 'title', that exact text is saved and nothing is spent. Synchronous: returns { title, clip_index, regenerated }. Does NOT use video quota.

style.description: Tone of the AI-generated title. Ignored when title is given.

title.description: Save this exact title instead of generating one (max 200 characters). Costs nothing.

name: katto_retitle_clip
